japanese_evidence.summary: Official training and evaluation cover English and Chinese; cross-lingual results do not establish Japanese preservation or quality.

blocking_reasons: Select and approve an immutable upstream commit.
Select an approved model artifact only after the license and Japanese offline gates are defined.

code.notes: Repository code is declared MIT; approval remains revision-specific.

weights.notes: The official model card declares MIT, subject to artifact digest and dependency review.

training_data.notes: Audit Emilia, LibriTTS, generated Seed-VC pairs, and every upstream data-use restriction.

inference_runtime.notes: Review tokenizer, speaker encoder, codec, and other bundled or downloaded runtime dependencies independently.

audio_contract.notes: The paper describes a non-causal 2.4-second window with current, overlap, and future regions; liveconv must measure the adapter plus resampling and network path independently.

target_preparation.procedure: Validate an authorized reference WAV, then precompute and reuse its mel conditioning and speaker embedding for the experiment run.

resource_budget_hypothesis.notes: Initial ceiling follows the class of the published RTX 3090 measurements, not a liveconv capacity result; lower budgets must be measured.

blockers.summary: Source revision and weight digest are not approved or pinned.
blockers.clear_when: A reviewed commit, weight SHA-256, and approval record are recorded.

blockers.summary: Training-data and inference dependency chains remain under review.
blockers.clear_when: The four-part license gate is approved for the intended deployment.

blockers.summary: No authorized target reference has been selected.
blockers.clear_when: Reference authorization, provenance, checksum, and retention policy are recorded.

blockers.summary: No official Japanese evaluation is available.
blockers.clear_when: The frozen Japanese offline experiment passes STT, speaker, integrity, and boundary rules.

adapter_conformance.criterion: Pass the common offline adapter contract before any streaming adapter is enabled.

warmup.criterion: Checkpoint and reusable target conditioning warm within the frozen timeout.

cancel.criterion: Cancel drops queued windows and prevents stale output from being accepted.

unload.criterion: Unload releases checkpoint and conditioning state; repeated reload remains healthy.

vram.criterion: Peak and post-unload VRAM meet a preregistered deployment-host budget.

stt.criterion: Japanese STT preservation and exact high-consequence entities pass offline.

speaker.criterion: Authorized-target similarity improves under the calibrated preregistered rule.

integrity.criterion: Audio integrity passes, including non-causal window and overlap boundary checks.

decision_notes: Treat X-VC as a quality candidate only after the Japanese offline gate; do not infer Japanese support from English and Chinese results.
